Cursor check in findFiltered stays IllegalArgumentException. Simplify BoardController.updateBoard double-lookup.

**Acceptance Criteria:** PATCH missing article → 404; payload-referenced checks stay 400; updateBoard has no findById pre-check; suite passes.

**Verify:** ./gradlew test

tasks.subject: Task 5: Extract FeedFetcher (single fetch path, charset fix)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One deep module owns HTTP feed retrieval (conditional requests, charset-correct decoding, error statuses) used by subscribe and polling; fixes platform-default-charset bug, removes Feed-mutation side channel, lastError uses e.toString().

**Files:** Create service/FetchResult.java, service/FeedFetcher.java, service/FeedFetchException.java, FeedFetcherTest.java; modify GlobalExceptionHandler (422), FeedService, FeedPollingService; update FeedServiceTest/FeedPollingServiceTest to mock FeedFetcher.

**Acceptance Criteria:** no RestClient.Builder in either service; ISO-8859-1 decode test passes; 304 → notModified, error → FeedFetchException → 422; lastError = e.toString(); suite passes.

**Verify:** ./gradlew test --tests "org.bartram.myfeeder.service.FeedFetcherTest" then ./gradlew test

Complete code: plan doc Task 5.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Make exponential backoff actually engage
tasks.description:
**Goal:** After each poll the scheduler re-reads error state and replaces the polling task when the effective interval changed; NotFoundException mid-poll cancels the feed. registerFeed keeps immediate-first-poll semantics.

**Files:** FeedPollingScheduler.java (full rewrite in plan doc), FeedPollingSchedulerTest.java (three tests, complete code in plan doc).

**Acceptance Criteria:** backoff interval applied after threshold crossed (captured-Runnable test, no waiting); no reschedule when unchanged; deleted feed cancelled; suite passes.

**Verify:** ./gradlew test --tests "org.bartram.myfeeder.scheduler.FeedPollingSchedulerTest" then ./gradlew test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/main/java/org/bartram/myfeeder/scheduler/FeedPollingScheduler.java", "src/test/java/org/bartram/myfeeder/scheduler/FeedPollingSchedulerTest.java"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew test --tests \"org.bartram.myfeeder.scheduler.FeedPollingSchedulerTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["backoff interval applied after threshold crossed without restart", "no reschedule when unchanged", "deleted feed cancelled", "suite passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

**Files:** Create event/FeedSavedEvent.java + event/FeedDeletedEvent.java; modify FeedService, OpmlImportService, FeedPollingScheduler, CLAUDE.md; update FeedServiceTest + OpmlImportServiceTest.

**Acceptance Criteria:** no scheduler dependency in services; AFTER_COMMIT + fallbackExecution listeners; no TransactionSynchronization; CLAUDE.md updated; suite passes.
